newsitem.title: POLAND: SWARZEDZ EXTENDS GAINS ON DM 200 MLN DEAL.
newsitem.headline: SWARZEDZ EXTENDS GAINS ON DM 200 MLN DEAL.

text.p: Polish furniture producer Swarzedz SA rose 9.5 percent to 9.25 zlotys, extending Thursday's 9.7-percent surge, on Wednesday's news that it had signed a 200-million-mark deal, traders said.
Swarzedz did not trade after price fixing due to excess demand and some traders said it might continue gaining next week. "I think it might go as high as 11 or 12 zlotys," one trader said.
Under the deal Swarzedz will produce furniture worth 200 million marks until 2002 for Germany's International Moebelhandelskantor Gmbh & Co KH (IMK), part of Schieder Group.
